thread:
Alex Chen: quick sync — we need to prioritize the v2 route compatibility work and lock launch criteria. customers (2 enterprise pilots) asked for a migration window and guaranteed fallback behavior. Can we decide tradeoffs today?
Maria Gonzalez: +1. Main asks: (1) stable function-calling signature, (2) embedding dims must match v1 for nav search, (3) fallback to `v1-compat` with preserved headers.
Sanjay Patel: are the embedding dim constraints strict? we can provide an alias mapping but dimension mismatch will break models that rely on exact vectors.
Maria Gonzalez: yes, they asserted that OSS similarity infra expects 1536 dims.
Alex Chen: proposal: keep v1 embeddings unchanged for now, add a `embed-compat` shim that pads/truncates with documented behavior. That buys time while we stabilize v2 models.
Priya Rao: sounds reasonable. what about tool-calling? many customers use typed args. v2 wants stricter JSON schema for outputs. we need a compatibility mode that accepts old loose shapes.
Sanjay Patel: compatibility mode seems fine, but it increases test surface. can we limit to a flag per-route so Dedicated/private customers can opt in?
Kevin Liu: ops note — per-route flag works for Dedicated and Private; Hosted we can expose an API param. need to decide rollout: opt-in beta -> canary -> default off for 30 days -> default on.
Alex Chen: launch criteria draft: 1) Migration guide published + sample repos; 2) automated compatibility tests passing (embedding parity + tool call golden set); 3) SLA for fallback (<500ms extra latency) validated under load; 4) docs for devs and SDK changes.
Maria Gonzalez: add: customer communication plan and a rollback playbook (how to flip to v1 routes for a tenant).
Sanjay Patel: for automated tests, i can own a small harness that runs embeddings and rerank comparisons against a fixed prompt set. estimate 3 dev days.
Kevin Liu: I'll own rollout stages and the canary orchestration. need an ops checklist with metrics (latency, error rate, token cost delta).
Priya Rao: on docs: we should include an explicit compat table: v1 field -> v2 field, transformation rules, examples. also include snippet for `curl` and SDK.
Alex Chen: sample shim config (for docs):
```json
{ "route": "/v2/embed", "compat_mode": true, "embed_padding": "zero_truncate", "tool_call_legacy": "allow_loose_types" }
```
Maria Gonzalez: +1. Also recommend we publish a small migration checklist for customers: backup prompts, run local evals, opt into beta, monitor logs.
Kevin Liu: timeline suggestion: lock tradeoffs EOD Fri, engineering spike next week (2w), docs + guides during spike, canary the following week.
Alex Chen: thanks — action items: (a) S.Patel to build test harness (b) K.Liu to prepare canary plan (c) M.Gonzalez to draft migration docs checklist (d) P.Rao to produce compat table + examples. We'll reconvene Tue to review progress.
deploy-bot: reminder — scheduled maintenance on infra next Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC (may affect canaries).
Priya Rao: noted — we'll avoid canary start during maintenance window.
Sanjay Patel: starting on harness tomorrow, will post updates in this thread.
Kevin Liu: I'll draft the metrics dashboard and share a link here when ready.
Alex Chen: appreciate it — aim to keep the migration story low-friction. small incremental switches vs big cutover. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: also capturing customer-specific exemptions: finance-pilot needs 3-month runway. we'll map that into rollout plan.
Alex Chen: perfect. closing the loop — thanks team.
